mission.title: Legwork
mission.description: Take a cheat code to the Merovingian and gather the fragments of his old assistants.

npc.say: This must be conducted in the utmost secrecy, understand?
Morpheus... The name makes me want to vomit! It was when he disabled my two assistants in such a cowardly fashion that I decided I would have to have him killed one day...
You are interfering with official government business. You are ordered to desist, and surrender yourself immediately!
Eh... Doesn't hurt to have an extra pair of legs around, does it?
Eh... Doesn't hurt to have an extra pair of legs around, does it?

phase.briefing:
Damn the Machines! They found out about our synthesized cheat codes. They've closed the coding sequence we were using to make them, and destroyed all the stock that we had--except for two.
I always knew these codes were a bad idea. They don't even grant great powers; all they do is scramble up RSI shells. Pshaw.
However, for some reason, the Merovingian wants one of our two remaining codes immediately. Since we don't want the Machines finding out about it, I'm going to have you, a nobody they would never suspect, get the code drug and take it to him. Well? Go pick it up!

enter.say: I'm scanning a code-shielded safe, and some heavy Exile programs in there.

objective.text: Get the code drug from the safe

done.say: All right. Your perimeter looks clear. Move out.

phase.briefing: What are you doing contacting me?! Maintain radio silence, fool!

enter.say: The big guy's in there, along with some heavyweight bodyguards. Scanners aren't showing any Machine activity in the area.

objective.text: Give the code drug to the Merovingian

done.say:
It's about time you got here. And it is high time I used this...
There. Ah, I see you are wondering what this means, non? That bastard, Morpheus, blew two of my most able assistants into the stratosphere some time ago. I have detected their code, floating about, but there was no way to pull it in...until now. These codes we developed have shown the ability to pull together pieces of program self-images. That is what we will do, now, for my old assistants. Flood will have further instructions for you.
Oh, man! I remember those dudes.

near.say: This must be conducted in the utmost secrecy, understand?
We should see what he wants us to do next.

phase.briefing:
It's a pity to have so much effort expended just to put together a few louts. Ah, well, I suppose not everything one does can be splendid--you know that better than anyone, eh, {player}?
So, we commence. The executed cheat code has begun pulling in fragments of the dispersed shells. We can track them by their unique code signal now that they are drifting down into range.
Two of them have come to rest nearby. Go gather them up, operative, before they hands fall into the wrong hands. Oho. Yes, I am feeling exceptionally droll today. Enjoy it.

enter.say:
Hunting for body parts, huh? How macabre. Except... They're technically not dead, so I guess that makes it... Heck, I don't know what that makes it.
Hm, careful in there. It looks like some Machine programs have come across our precious limbs. You might have to take them off Machine bodies... Uh-oh, this is getting confusing again.

objective.text: Get the Twin Legs Frag from the Machine Captain

done.say: Now there's something you don't see every day.

objective.text: Get the Twin Feet Frag from Tactical Security

done.say: Phew! Did those pick up that nasty funk from floating around all this time, or were they that way to begin with?

phase.briefing:
Not the pieces I would have chosen, perhaps...
You're supposed to take those to the Effectuator now. I find it hard to believe that fool can put his own shoes on the right feet, much less someone else's feet on their correct legs.

enter.say: Great, looks like the Effectuator's split himself again. You'll probably have to give one fragment to each of him.

objective.text: Give the Legs to the Effectuator

done.say: Okay. See what he's gonna do with 'em.

objective.text: Give the Feet to the Effectuator

done.say: Hey, amigo! What a way to meet, huh? Lemme just take these and... Shazam!
Yikes! I'm scanning... What am I scanning? It looks like a partial program shell in there... Can you, uh, talk to it?
Whoa! Lively little guys, aren't they?

mission.finish: Lovely. Obviously, this undignified state of affairs cannot be allowed to continue. I will have more gathering to do for you, {player}, just as soon as we pick up the code signals of the other fragments.
